title: Fluorescein dispensing characterization of the modified OT-2 sub-microliter liquid handling
goal: Measure the accuracy and reproducibility of 5-500 nL fluorescein dispenses into buffer-filled wells, quantified by fluorescence against hand-pipetted standards.

title: Autosampling LC-MS of HeLa digest with sample-loop overfilling versus underfilling
goal: Demonstrate nanoLC-MS autosampling of 0.25-10 ng HeLa digest and compare protein and peptide identifications between overfilled and underfilled loop injections.
